subject: Using WAIC in the model leads to "Fail to factorize Q"

messages.author: a1d13288b3444094
messages.subject: Using WAIC in the model leads to "Fail to factorize Q"
parts:
Hi,

I have been trying to fit the following model in INLA:

formula_iid = inla.surv(age,status) ~ education + wealth + f(District, model="iid",graph="US.graph", values = US.gen$NAME_2, adjust.for.con.comp=TRUE)

model_iid = inla(formula_iid,family="coxph", data=df,
             verbose=TRUE, control.hazard=list(model="rw1",n.intervals=20),control.inla = list(cmin = 0),
             keep=T, weights = df$weights, control.compute = list(waic=TRUE))

If I don't use "control.compute = list(waic=TRUE)", then the model runs fine and I get results. But when I use "control.compute = list(waic=TRUE)", the model runs for forever until the battery drains out and I keep seeing this on the screen:

max.logdens= -102918.7280 fn= 17 theta= 0.5547 3.7932  range=[-4.78 2.42]

file: smtp-taucs.c  hgid: f83f00640846  date: Tue May 08 10:16:23 2018 +0300
Function: GMRFLib_factorise_sparse_matrix_TAUCS(), Line: 859, Thread: 0
Fail to factorize Q. I will try to fix it...

Any idea, how to fix this?

Thanks in advance.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Using WAIC in the model leads to "Fail to factorize Q"
parts:
This will imply that the model in numerical singular. Try to scale the covariates and also age
